_about: The board's trip promo (npm run print:gala -- trips). Facts (title, nights, travelers, what's included, hero photo and its credit) come from src/data/galaTrips.ts, which is ported from the trip kit. This file holds only what the promo adds: each trip's public price for the whole package (never per person; never the kit's internal listPrice, never SparkPoint's share), an optional priceNote (default 'airfare not included'; never write 'land only', Jeff's call 2026-11-16), the short line under the name, and three highlights (from the trip packs' packs.json). Rules: no auction or bidding words, never name the package provider, don't say how or when payment happens, child pricing, insurance or transferability, and never say a trip can be chosen after the Gala.
